description: Reusable verification profiles for the UE5 agentic factory. Profiles are referenced by Planner output, handoffs, and Critic. Commands are recorded only if actually discovered. Profiles without discovered commands are marked unavailable and will block autonomous promotion for tasks requiring them.

text-only.purpose: Validate text changes, schemas, specs, code, configs, manifests, and documentation without running Unreal.
expected_evidence: Test-ShellGuard.ps1 exit 0 with suite and per-rule coverage counts
text-only.notes: Default safe profile for pure source and spec tasks. Test-ShellGuard.ps1 is text-only (no Unreal), runs in seconds, and is also invoked first by gate.ps1; it verifies the shell-policy classifier corpus, its fuzz/property invariants, the live PreToolUse hook, and that the run left agent_collab/state/ byte-identical. Any change under agent_collab/scripts/, agent_collab/tests/, agent_collab/context/command_policy.json, command-policy-spec.md, or agent_collab/adapters/*/hooks/ requires it — see the exemption carve-out in AGENTS.md.

compile.purpose: Compile the project (Development Editor target for the Gloamstead module) to catch C++ and build errors.
expected_evidence: build log showing success or specific errors for the Gloamstead module
compile.unavailable_reason: No command-line build wrapper or discovered path to UnrealEditor-Cmd / MSBuild for the project discovered. Requires human to open .uproject or run Visual Studio build.
compile.notes: Per README: open .uproject, generate VS project files, build Development Editor for Gloamstead module.

editor-generation.purpose: Run approved editor automation, commandlets, or scripts that generate or configure project-owned content.
expected_evidence: list of new/changed files under Content/Data/
editor-generation.notes: Whitelisted wrapper invokes GloamsteadImportDataAssets commandlet. Human runs compile + import script; see specs/data/HUMAN_RUN_IMPORT.md.

map-load.purpose: Open generated or modified maps to confirm they load without errors, missing references, or PCG failures.
expected_evidence: relevant log excerpts showing no critical load errors
map-load.unavailable_reason: No command-line map load validator discovered. Requires human to load in Unreal Editor or PIE with log capture.
map-load.notes: Critical for any task producing or modifying maps.

automation-test.purpose: Run UE Automation Framework tests (unit or functional) relevant to the task or slice.
expected_evidence: test results report (passed/failed counts and logs)
GATE PASS line naming the green test count
automation-test.notes: Corrected 2026-07-29: this profile previously claimed no runner existed. gate.ps1 at the repo root IS the runner and is the documented authority (AGENTS.md). Order: the text-only shell-guard suite runs FIRST (fail-fast, seconds), then it builds GloamsteadEditor, runs the Gloamstead automation filter via UnrealEditor-Cmd, parses index.json and fails closed on no-report/zero-tests/any non-Success, then runs five nonce-bound GloamsteadForge evidence validators. Still requires_human because it needs the editor closed and is RAM-heavy on the current machine.

functional-test.purpose: Execute functional or integration tests (may overlap with automation-test or manual PIE flows).
expected_evidence: test execution log and pass/fail summary
functional-test.unavailable_reason: No functional test infrastructure or scripts discovered.

package-smoke.purpose: Cook and package a minimal build and perform a launch smoke test.
package-smoke.unavailable_reason: No packaging or cook scripts discovered in the repository.

candidate-integration.purpose: Full integration verification on a candidate branch, combining applicable profiles based on the wave's tasks.
expected_evidence: results from all required profiles for the wave
candidate-integration.unavailable_reason: Depends on other profiles; text-only aspects can be automated, UE-dependent aspects require human.
candidate-integration.notes: The active Orchestrator assembles the set of profiles required by the tasks in the wave.

human-playtest.purpose: Capture structured human feedback on playability, fun, coherence, pacing, visuals, and readiness of a slice.
expected_evidence: recorded result in outbox/playtest/ with ratings for visual coherence, navigation clarity, objective clarity, combat feel, pacing, performance feel, overall readiness, plus free-text notes
human-playtest.notes: Mandatory gate for any task or slice that declares requires_human_playtest: true. Orchestrator records the result; does not perform the playtest.

usage: Planner includes required_verification_profiles per task. Handoffs pass the list. Critic verifies execution and results (or proper documented reasons for skips). Unavailable profiles block promotion for tasks that list them as required.
